profile.headline: Engineering Tech Lead at Bishop Fox

positions.title: Manager: Penetration Testing
positions.description:
- Conducted over 100 client engagements spanning several types of testing including external, internal, web application, mobile application, thick client application, wireless, physical, and segmentation validation.
- Mentored and led junior penetration testers.
- Developed custom exploitation tools and modified existing open source tools to accommodate testing requirements.
- Developed and enhanced reporting automation, saving hundreds of hours of reporting time for the team.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
- Performed red teaming activities in classified environments.
- Developed Python modules for an incident response framework.

positions.title: Cyber Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Built the IP hopping component that performs hopping in an IPv6 address space.
- Developed network measurement collection routines to achieve dynamic IP hopping.
- Rewrote offensive IP hopping tool with deeper integration with Linux network internals, greatly enhancing reliability.

projects.title: Appliance for Active Repositioning in Cyberspace (AARC)
projects.description: Program Manager and Principal Investigator for a project to create a network appliance (based on the ARCSYNE project) that transparently performs IP hopping at a network gateway in order to deter adversaries through confusion and resource exhaustion.
